item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. We should prepare now to use it to improve public services, make better decisions and meet people’s needs.

2. We believe superintelligent AI, if built within the next 20 years, will make every government more effective. That means better tools for public servants and stronger capacity to deliver for everyone.

3. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will make every government more effective. We can start preparing today—building the skills, systems and safeguards governments need to put this technology to work for the public.

**(b) Newsletter opening (109 words)**

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. That could mean public services that respond faster, decisions informed by more complete analysis, and public servants better equipped to address complex challenges. This is not a distant issue for governments to consider later. The choices we make now—about expertise, infrastructure, oversight and public trust—will shape whether governments are ready to use powerful AI well. We are focused on helping public institutions prepare for this shift and turn new capabilities into practical improvements for the people they serve. The opportunity is significant, and we should begin building that capacity today.
